#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int ans = 0;
    char prev = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == prev) {
            count++;
        } else {
            if (count > 0 && count % 2 == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            prev = c;
            count = 1;
        }
    }
    if (count % 2 == 0) {
        ans++;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
